svg.text: Ambient column: hanging boxes, one carriage, a nest level and a cool section
Lidded GN 1/6 boxes hang by their rims in two rack faces; one carriage in the aisle fetches any box and lifts it to the roof hatch.
72 lidded (30 S, 27 M, 15 T) + 9 cool + ≤ 37 nested empties
retrieval worst ≈ 6 s, mean ≈ 4 s · 3 motors, hook passive
cool section 8–15 °C: 40 W Peltier, insulated roller shutter
A SIDE SECTION (room on the left)
The carriage runs in X (lanes) and Z (levels) and reaches
into either face in Y; the passive J-hook engages by a 5 mm lift.
S = GN 1/6-65, M = 1/6-100, T = 1/6-150; the column is full.
Box hand-over below the gallery floor:
lidded box 60 mm · empty from the nest 285 mm
Boxes never touch each other; every box is within
one box of a human hand through the door.
1/5 A lidded box from the rear face: the carriage reaches in, lifts it 5 mm off its runners and brings it up under the roof hatch.
2/5 The gallery hook reaches 60 mm down through the hatch and takes it.
3/5 Cool section (8–15 °C): the insulated roller shutter rolls up only while the carriage takes a box out.
4/5 Empty boxes live nested without lids in one tall level: the nest comes up, the hook takes the top empty (285 mm down).
5/5 Put-away: the gallery sets a used box on the carriage, which hangs it in a free slot of the front face.
